_about: How many kinds of mineral there were on Earth, by stage: Hazen's mineral evolution. Minerals set what can be made; the count jumps when the air gets oxygen. Each point [year, value, low, high]; year is the store's astronomer's year. Made by tools/curves-deep-time.py.

source.citation: Hazen, R.M. et al. (2008), Mineral evolution, American Mineralogist 93, 1693–1720, the ten stages and their counts; Hazen, R.M. (2012), The Story of Earth
source.note: the counts are Hazen's of 2008 (about 4,400 kinds then known); the catalogue has grown to about 6,000 since by finding, not by Earth changing, so the curve keeps the 2008 scale throughout

howSure: The stages are well argued; the counts within them are estimates, and the band says so. The jump at 2.4 billion years is the one firm thing.
